headline: Fisherman's Row Line Broken; Callahan's Passage Wholly Warden
war_summary: Three of Fisherman's Row's nine strongpoints have gone to waste since the last edition, breaking the all-Colonial line that stood there; the region still reports four events in the past two hours and fifty-one across the day. Callahan's Passage, the war's heaviest ground, now flies Warden colors over all ten squares, its last Colonial holdout gone, with sixty-four events in twenty-four hours and The Latch accounting for thirty-three of them. Stlican Shelf has firmed to six Colonial squares against two Warden, one laid waste, after fifty-seven events and hard fighting at Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost. The Weathered Expanse has come down to seven Colonial, one Warden and one waste. Nevish Line holds seven Warden squares to one Colonial under continued fire, while Mooring County remains eleven Warden to one Colonial and carries the day's costliest fighting. Viper Pit, wholly Warden, reports the sharpest casualty exchange of the hour, some 406 Colonial and 309 Warden, without any change of colors. Across 436 strongpoints the Colonial banner flies over roughly 307, the Warden over 124, and five lie waste.
